import sys
import re

def longest_words(line):
    # Split by underscore and return max length of parts, or 0 if empty
    parts = line.split('_')
    return max((len(p) for p in parts), default=0)

def trim_parentheses(s):
    # Remove first and last character (parentheses)
    return s[1:-1]

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    # First token is n (integer), second token is the input string
    n = int(data[0])
    input_str = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    
    pattern = r'\([\w_]*\)'
    # Split by pattern to get parts outside parentheses
    outside_parts = re.split(pattern, input_str)
    longest = max((longest_words(part) for part in outside_parts), default=0)
    
    # Find all matches inside parentheses
    matches = re.findall(pattern, input_str)
    number_inside = 0
    for m in matches:
        inside = trim_parentheses(m)
        # Split by underscore and count non-empty parts
        parts = inside.split('_')
        number_inside += sum(1 for p in parts if p)
    
    print(f"{longest} {number_inside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
